correctness.rationale: For S=P1×P1 over F2, the 511 nonzero (2,2) sections undergo four-chart polynomial/Jacobian ideal smoothness tests; independent exact arithmetic obtains 144 smooth sections, all 804 qualifying pencils and their 13 orbits under the 72-element group. For 13 orbit representatives, 52 four-chart transversality ideals equal unit ideal, yielding eight reduced base points by intersection number 8. Direct independent finite-field extension enumeration degrees 1..8 and Möbius inversion reproduces all five Frobenius cycle profiles and weighted pencil/orbit counts. Exhaustive finite field and algebraic-closure ideal criteria are mathematical completeness argument; code logs alone not relied on.
